summary: Transpose of a 4x4 float matrix (row-major, 16 floats at +0x00..+0x3C) written from a2 into a1. The six off-diagonal symmetric pairs are unconditionally swapped via temporaries; the four diagonal elements (+0x00, +0x14, +0x28, +0x3C) are copied only when a1 != a2, which makes the routine support in-place transposition. Returns a1 (the destination pointer).

local_names.a1: destination matrix pointer; also the return value
local_names.v2: temporary holding the +4/+16 source float during swap
local_names.v4: temporary holding the +8/+32 source float during swap
local_names.v5: temporary holding the +12/+48 source float during swap
local_names.v6: temporary holding the +24/+36 source float during swap
local_names.v7: temporary holding the +28/+52 source float during swap
local_names.v8: temporary holding the +44/+56 source float during swap

operations.description: Swap elements at +0x04 and +0x10: save a2+4 in v2, write a2+16 into a1+4, then write v2 into a1+16 (transpose pair (0,1)/(1,0))
Swap elements at +0x08 and +0x20: save a2+8 in v4, write a2+32 into a1+8, then write v4 into a1+32 (transpose pair (0,2)/(2,0))
Swap elements at +0x0C and +0x30: save a2+12 in v5, write a2+48 into a1+12, then write v5 into a1+48 (transpose pair (0,3)/(3,0))
Swap elements at +0x18 and +0x24: save a2+24 in v6, write a2+36 into a1+24, then write v6 into a1+36 (transpose pair (1,2)/(2,1))
Swap elements at +0x1C and +0x34: save a2+28 in v7, write a2+52 into a1+28, then write v7 into a1+52 (transpose pair (1,3)/(3,1))
Swap elements at +0x2C and +0x38: save a2+44 in v8, write a2+56 into a1+44, then write v8 into a1+56 (transpose pair (2,3)/(3,2))
When a1 != a2 the diagonal elements are copied from a2 to a1; when a1 == a2 they are already in place (in-place transpose support)
Copy the four diagonal elements +0x00, +0x14, +0x28, +0x3C from a2 to a1 inside the a1 != a2 guard
Return a1, the destination matrix pointer
